memories.author: D05
memories.text: Patient presents with fatigue and mild exertional dyspnea, with known dyslipidaemia, hypertension, and suspected vitamin B12 deficiency. She reports low energy for past two months, occasional palpitations, and no chest pain. On examination, BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 78/min regular, BMI 26.2 kg/m2, lungs clear, cardiac sounds normal without murmurs, no peripheral edema. She denies smoking, alcohol occasional. Baseline labs ordered.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atorvastatin 10 mg HS
Amlodipine 5 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (<100), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 210 mg/dL (<150). Vitamin B12 180 pg/mL (200-900). Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12-16), MCV 98 fL (80-100). Liver function: ALT 22 U/L (<40), AST 20 U/L (<40), ALP 78 U/L (<120). Creatine kinase 150 U/L (<200). Serum creatinine 0.8 mg/dL (0.6-1.1), eGFR 92 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Serum potassium 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more tired lately and my heart sometimes races when I climb stairs. I’m worried my blood pressure might be up again.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Hypertension uncontrolled, LDL still high, vitamin B12 low-normal. Patient reports persistent fatigue and occasional palpitations. BP 142/88 mmHg, pulse 80/min, lungs clear, S1S2 normal. No edema. Repeat labs show modest lipid improvement but LDL remains elevated; B12 210 pg/mL; creatinine 0.82, eGFR 89; potassium 4.4.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rosuvastatin 10 mg OD
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 124 mg/dL (<100), HDL 50 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 190 mg/dL (<150). Vitamin B12 210 pg/mL (200-900). Haemoglobin 13.0 g/dL (12-16), MCV 97 fL (80-100). Serum creatinine 0.82 mg/dL (0.6-1.1), eGFR 89 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Serum potassium 4.4 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-09-01 at 10:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Blood pressure well controlled, triglycerides borderline, vitamin B12 now adequate. Patient feels more energetic, no palpitations. BP 124/78 mmHg, pulse 72/min, lungs clear, cardiovascular normal. Labs show LDL 110, triglycerides 165, B12 340 pg/mL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rosuvastatin 10 mg OD
Fenofibrate 145 mg OD
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Amlodipine 5 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 110 mg/dL (<100), HDL 52 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150). Liver function: ALT 24 U/L (<40), AST 22 U/L (<40), ALP 80 U/L (<120). Creatine kinase 148 U/L (<200). Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200-900). Serum creatinine 0.80 mg/dL (0.6-1.1), eGFR 91 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Serum potassium 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Patient reports mild muscle aches in shoulders and thighs over past month, no weakness. CK elevated on prior labs. BP 126/80 mmHg, pulse 74/min, lungs clear, cardiovascular normal. No rash or jaundice.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rosuvastatin 10 mg OD
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Amlodipine 5 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
Fenofibrate stopped

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Creatine kinase 320 U/L (<200) elevated. Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (<40), AST 26 U/L (<40), ALP 85 U/L (<120). Lipid profile: LDL 108 mg/dL (<100), HDL 53 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 158 mg/dL (<150). Serum creatinine 0.79 mg/dL (0.6-1.1), eGFR 93 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Serum potassium 4.2 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Stable on current regimen. Patient asymptomatic, CK normalizing after fenofibrate stop. BP 122/78 mmHg, pulse 70/min, lungs clear, cardiovascular normal. Plans to continue rosuvastatin, telmisartan, amlodipine, methylcobalamin; monitor lipids and B12 annually.
